statement: HBM supply shortage persists, with HBM described as sold out through 2026 and TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging lead times reported exceeding twelve months as the binding bottleneck.
why: If packaging capacity rather than memory wafers is the true limit, then adding HBM wafer capacity alone will not increase finished accelerator output.

impact.mechanism: Advanced-packaging lead times beyond a year cap how much HBM can be assembled into shipping accelerators, holding effective supply below demand.

evidence.excerpt: TSMC CoWoS advanced-packaging lead times reported exceeding twelve months, cited as the binding bottleneck limiting HBM output expansion; HBM described as "sold out through 2026."

confidence.basis: Secondary source, and this passage is explicitly flagged in the document as corroborating background from a search round rather than the article's own reporting.
